queries:
SELECT c.name,
       ABS(COUNT(r.raceId) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) - 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) FROM races)) AS margin
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name;
SELECT c.name
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) > 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits);
WITH c AS (
  SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS n FROM races GROUP BY circuitId
),
s AS (
  SELECT circuitId, n / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c
)
SELECT circuitId, (share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)) / (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS relative_margin
FROM s;
